facts.raw_span: A 63-year-old woman presented with difficult-to-treat hypertension
bone and central diabetes insipidus diagnosed via femoral biopsy 12 years ago
liver involvement three years prior that was treated with cytarabine for one year
untreated dyslipidemia (LDL cholesterol 3.11 mmol/L)
She was not a smoker and did not have diabetes
body mass index was 19.22 kg/m²
Blood pressure was 198/106 mmHg
heart rate was 65 beats/min
a continuous murmur was heard in the epigastric region
Serum creatinine: 96.36 μmol/L (1.09 mg/dL)
B-type natriuretic peptide: 82,500 pg/mL
Abdominal CT angiogram: high-grade ostial stenosis of the left renal, celiac trunk, and superior mesenteric arteries
